description: For a logo file on the user's machine that cannot be sent inside a tool call: returns a mark id and a one-shot HTTPS PUT URL. Upload the raw file bytes to it (for example `curl -T logo.png "<uploadUrl>"`), then call build_logo_editor_link with the mark id (or create_image_logo_project when signed in). Accepts PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP (8 MB) and SVG (1 MB).

file_name.description: The file name, used as the project title later

name: request_logo_image_upload

uploadUrl.description: Absolute https URL the user can open

title: Request an upload URL for a logo file
